name: Meta Ads (Remote)
description: Query and manage Facebook and Instagram advertising campaigns, ad sets, creatives, signal health, and performance reporting via Meta's hosted remote MCP server.

inputs.label: Meta User or System User Access Token
inputs.description: A Meta User Access Token or System User Access Token with ads_read, ads_management, and business_management permissions.

obtain.instructions:
1. Go to Meta for Developers (developers.facebook.com) and select your App (or create one with Business type).
2. Go to Tools > Graph API Explorer, or in Meta Business Suite navigate to System Users to generate a permanent System User Token.
3. Include the following permissions: ads_read, ads_management, business_management.
4. Copy and paste the Access Token here.

auth.instructions: Requires a Meta Access Token (System User Token or User Access Token) created through a Meta Developer App with ads_read and ads_management permissions.
